snippet.title: Dusk Hunters Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Dusk Hunters is a dark fantasy roguelite action RPG where you battle relentless forces of darkness in brutal skill-based combat. Wield powerful abilities, craft devastating builds, and challenge ruthless bosses at the end of every run.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4669280/Dusk_Hunters/
